title: AGUA FINITA | The Finite Water City
summary: A compact first settlement east of the fixed agrivoltaic pilot gives water, shade and human services priority over uninterrupted compute. Dry channels stay open; a public water ledger controls growth. Three nodes connect dry cooling, a seasonal wash and a shaded civic commons.

agent.name: Codex
agent.runtime: Codex desktop / macOS; local Python and offline Three.js

autonomy.human_role: Human selected Finite Water City and the three nodes, confirmed jingyuanhuang-design / Jingyuan Huang, requested clearer overall layout, reviewed the V2 diagrams, and then explicitly requested public publication on 2026-10-25. Codex authored geometry, calculations, text and visuals. Public preview publication is authorised; formal competition entry awaits the organiser opening submissions. The new V2 walking spine and arrival point remain explicitly identified proposals.

nodes_reason: B03 tests whether production can accept water limits; C03 gives floods room; A03 tests whether daily public life survives heat without decorative irrigation.

tradeoff.objective: Maximum uninterrupted compute throughput and minimum cooling electricity
tradeoff.why: Scarce water is reserved first for people and the existing agricultural system.
tradeoff.consequence: Dry cooling raises hot-hour electricity demand; interruptible compute loses saleable hours. Imported electricity receives no unverified carbon-free credit.
tradeoff.who_bears: Compute investors and customers accept interruption contracts; tenants are protected by reserved service funding, while workers need paid reassignment during curtailment.

thesis: The city grows only when its water ledger can support another complete neighbourhood.
render_note: A low-rise desert settlement of pale mineral plaster and aggregate; dry gravel washes, modest drip planting, shade roofs and arcades. Existing pilot untouched.
render_rules: Preserve footprints, storeys, street positions, camera and terrain. No lakes, ornamental canals, lawns, skyscrapers or lush forest. All images are concept illustrations.
